title: The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery
focus_en: Connects idea generation, coding, experiments, reporting, and automated review in an inspectable ML research workflow.
focus_zh: 把 idea 生成、编码、实验、报告和自动评审连接为可检查的 ML 科研流程。
boundary_en: The original experiments use human-written code templates. Automated reviewer scores do not establish independent scientific significance.
boundary_zh: 原始实验依赖人工编写的代码模板；自动评审分数不能确立独立的科学价值。

title: The AI Scientist-v2: Workshop-Level Automated Scientific Discovery via Agentic Tree Search
focus_en: Uses an experiment manager and agentic tree search to explore hypotheses and run ML experiments without v1's human-authored code templates.
focus_zh: 通过实验管理 agent 与 agentic tree search 探索假设、运行 ML 实验，解除 v1 对人工代码模板的依赖。
boundary_en: The paper reports a limited workshop submission case study. Acceptance is one evaluation signal, not proof of general research taste.
boundary_zh: 论文报告的是有限的 workshop 投稿案例；录用是一种评价信号，不代表已验证通用 research taste。

title: AI-Researcher: Autonomous Scientific Innovation
focus_en: Combines literature review, hypothesis generation, implementation, and reporting. Scientist-Bench distinguishes guided innovation from exploration within supplied research topics.
focus_zh: 结合文献综述、假设生成、实现与报告；Scientist-Bench 区分引导式创新与给定研究主题内的探索。
boundary_en: Implementation success and paper-quality ratings are distinct from independently replicated discoveries or unconstrained agenda selection.
boundary_zh: 实现成功率与论文质量评分，需要与独立复现的发现、开放式研究议题选择区分。

title: Agent Laboratory: Using LLM Agents as Research Assistants
focus_en: Provides an inspectable pipeline from a human research idea to literature review, experiments, and reports, with human feedback at intermediate stages.
focus_zh: 提供从人工研究 idea 到文献综述、实验和报告的可检查流程，并支持各阶段的人类反馈。
boundary_en: Starts with a human-provided idea; it is evidence about research assistance and execution, not autonomous selection of worthwhile questions.
boundary_zh: 从人类提供的 idea 出发，主要验证科研协作与执行，不直接验证自主选择有价值问题的能力。

title: Accelerating scientific discovery with Co-Scientist
focus_en: Generates, critiques, ranks, and evolves hypotheses conditioned on scientists' objectives, with experimental follow-up in biomedical case studies.
focus_zh: 围绕科学家给定的目标生成、批评、排序和演化假设，并在生物医学案例中开展后续实验验证。
boundary_en: Hypothesis evolution uses test-time computation. Human-defined objectives and laboratory validation remain part of the workflow; cross-project taste learning is not established.
boundary_zh: 假设演化使用 test-time computation；流程仍包含人工目标与实验室验证，尚未确立跨项目的 taste 学习。

title: Kosmos: An AI Scientist for Autonomous Discovery
focus_en: Maintains a structured world model across literature search, hypothesis generation, and data analysis to support longer investigations.
focus_zh: 通过结构化 world model 连接文献搜索、假设生成与数据分析，支持更长程的研究。
boundary_en: Starts from a supplied objective and dataset. Traceable reports can still contain errors or statistically significant but scientifically unimportant findings.
boundary_zh: 从给定目标与数据集出发；可追溯的报告仍可能包含错误，或统计显著但科学意义有限的结果。

title: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models
focus_en: Combines LLM program generation, executable evaluation, and evolutionary search for mathematical constructions and algorithms.
focus_zh: 结合 LLM 程序生成、可执行评价与演化搜索，寻找数学构造和算法。
boundary_en: The objective and evaluator are supplied by humans. Released research code excludes the language model, sandbox, and distributed infrastructure.
boundary_zh: 目标和 evaluator 由人类提供；公开研究代码不包含语言模型、沙箱和分布式基础设施。

title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
focus_en: Evolves algorithm implementations using LLM proposals and automated evaluator feedback across mathematical and computational tasks.
focus_zh: 利用 LLM 候选方案与自动 evaluator 的反馈，演化数学和计算任务中的算法实现。
boundary_en: Requires an executable objective and evaluation procedure. Verified improvements within supplied tasks do not measure the value of self-selected research questions.
boundary_zh: 需要可执行的目标与评价过程；给定任务内的已验证改进，不等于自主选题价值的评价。

title: autoresearch
focus_en: A compact modify-train-evaluate-retain loop for single-GPU language-model training, useful as an accessible research execution baseline.
focus_zh: 面向单 GPU 语言模型训练的修改—训练—评价—保留循环，可作为简洁的科研执行 baseline。
boundary_en: Optimizes a fixed metric in short training runs. Research instructions are human-written; metric gains do not demonstrate question selection or learned taste.
boundary_zh: 在短时训练中优化固定指标，研究指令由人类编写；指标提升不能验证问题选择或 taste 学习。

title: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement
focus_en: Stores hypotheses, experimental artifacts, evidence, and reusable lessons in a persistent tree managed by a coordinator and isolated executors.
focus_zh: 用持久化假设树保存假设、实验产物、证据与可复用经验，由 coordinator 和隔离的 executors 管理。
boundary_en: Evaluated mainly as autonomous optimization of supplied artifacts and objectives. Evidence accumulation is not by itself broad scientific question selection.
boundary_zh: 主要评价给定产物与目标下的自主优化；证据积累本身不能等同于广泛的科学问题选择。

title: Towards Autonomous Mathematics Research
focus_en: Iterates generation, verification, revision, and literature use for research-level mathematics; also discusses autonomy, novelty, and human contribution reporting.
focus_zh: 在研究级数学问题上迭代生成、验证、修订与文献使用，并讨论自主程度、新颖性和人类贡献的记录。
boundary_en: Uses natural-language reasoning, not universal formal proof checking. The linked release contains prompts and outputs, not the complete agent implementation.
boundary_zh: 采用自然语言推理，并非所有结果都经过形式化证明检查；链接公开的是 prompts 与输出，不是完整 agent 实现。
